name: ckg-knowledge-receipt
_doc: Runs the conformance invariants against Graphify.md's CKG Receipt /sign/demo endpoint. Knowledge receipt = Layer 4 of the four-layer governance stack (settlement → action → verdict → knowledge). issuer_id (graphifymd.com) is structurally distinct from agent_id — the signer cannot be the party whose knowledge is in question. Public key resolves from https://ckg-receipt.onrender.com/keys (out-of-band, never embedded in the receipt). sig_scheme: ed25519-jcs (Ed25519 over JCS/RFC-8785 canonical bytes).
